HOSTING_FEATURES_CODES.doc: The hosting codes of the features dimension: hosting.features.*, the verdict and refusal codes a qualifier, a host or the console write and read by code, never by prose (docs/data-layout.md).

featuresAtomInUnfed.doc: a non-MIDI atom input no buffer here can feed

text.en: This plugin declares a non-MIDI atom input that nothing here can feed. Run it where that input can be fed, or accept it stays empty.
This plugin needs a host feature this host does not provide. Run it on a host that provides that feature.
This plugin’s MIDI input is fed nothing. Connect a source of MIDI, or accept it runs with none.
This plugin is missing a feature it needs to run here. Provide that feature, or run it elsewhere.

featuresPortsUnreadable.doc: the plugin declares ports its reader cannot read (a port node shared by several plugins of one bundle, a port with no symbol), so none reaches the host: the bundle's data is the fault, not the layout (omx-clap-core#255)

text.en: This plugin declares ports its reader cannot read, so none of them reach the host. The fault is in the plugin’s own bundle, not in this host.
This plugin has every feature it needs.
This plugin was scanned before this field existed, so it was never checked for it. Scan it again to check.
